facts.fact: POTRAZ states it is the designated Data Protection Authority under section 5 of the Act and is acting as such, having trained data protection officers and engaged organisations for over two years.

The Cyber and Data Protection (Licensing of Data Controllers and Appointment of Data Protection Officers) Regulations, 2024 (SI 155 of 2024) came into effect in September 2024, requiring a Data Controller Licence with an initial compliance deadline of 12 March 2025, per POTRAZ.

POTRAZ Regulatory Notice 2 of 2026, signed by its director-general, announces mandatory compliance inspections and assessments of data controllers from 1 September 2026, risk-based and starting with financial, insurance, local authority, health and mining sectors; no sanction is reported. Notice date not given, so the published date is used.
POTRAZ moved from awareness and training to announcing mandatory compliance inspections from 1 September 2026 under the Act; notice date not given, so the published date is used.
